Default.tutorialIntroText: ($1) - in a moment, tell me whether you want Ludio to teach your group how to play this game!
Default.whoNeedsTutorialQuestion: ($1), who needs the tutorial? Click on the players or select from the middle.
Default.forceStopQuestion: ($1), force any active player to stop drawing cards!
Default.forceFlipQuestion: ($1), force any active player to HIT 3 times RIGHT NOW!
Default.overviewText:
The game is played with a custom deck of cards containing the numbers 0-12 and some special cards.

A round consists of multiple turns. Every turn, each player votes to Hit or Stop. If you hit, you are dealt another card. The numbers on the cards get added to your total score. If you hit and you are dealt a card you already have, you bust and lose your points in that round. The round ends when everyone busts or stops, and the next round starts.

If you are dealt 7 unique number cards, you have made a Rainbow draw. This ends the round immediately and you get 25 bonus points.

The first player to reach 200 points wins!
Default.modifiersText: The deck contains cards that say +2, +4, +6, +8, +10, and x2. These cards do exactly what they say and do not count towards your unique number cards. Multiplication happens before addition.
Default.actionsText:
These are 3 special action cards: Stop, Hit 3, and Extra Life.

If you are dealt a Stop card, you must play it on any player that is still in the round. They will be forced to stop drawing cards for the rest of the round. You can only play Stop cards on players with higher scores (unless you're the highest score). If you are the only remaining player, any Stop cards you draw have no effect.

If you are dealt a Hit 3 card, you must play it on any player that is still in the round. They are dealt 3 more cards immediately.

If you are dealt an Extra Life card, it stays in your hand for the rest of the round. If you ever bust, the Extra Life saves you - the card that would have busted you gets discarded along with your Extra Life card and you keep playing.

If you draw a Stop or Hit 3 card while in the middle of a Hit 3 action, those cards have no effect unless it is the 3rd card you are dealt.
Default.noActionText: If you fail to take an action, a random action will be chosen for you.
Default.noSpecialActionText: If you do not choose a player for the Stop/Hit action, a random valid player will be chosen for you.

Default.naughtyOverviewText:
Naughty mode is played with a bigger, meaner deck: the numbers run 0-13, and there is no Extra Life card to save you.

Everything else works the same. Every turn each player chooses Hit or Stop. Hit and you are dealt another card. Draw a number you already have and you bust, losing your points for that round.

If you are dealt 7 unique number cards, you have made a Rainbow draw. That ends the round immediately and you get 25 bonus points.

Naughty is a shorter game than Nice: the first player to reach 150 points wins!
Default.naughtyModifiersText:
In Naughty mode every modifier hurts. The deck contains -2, -4, -6, -8, -10 and ÷2. They do exactly what they say and do not count towards your unique number cards. The ÷2 is applied first (rounding down), then the minuses are subtracted.

You never keep a penalty you draw. The moment one turns up you pick another player who is still drawing and it goes in front of them instead. Players who have busted or already stopped are safe from it. If there is nobody left who is still drawing, the penalty stays with you.
Default.naughtyActionsText:
There are 5 action cards, and each one is played on another player the moment you draw it.

One More - the player you pick is dealt one more card and is then forced to stop.

Hit 4 - the player you pick is dealt 4 more cards immediately.

Steal - pick a player, then take any one of their number or modifier cards for yourself. Careful: if you steal a number you already have, you bust.

Swap - pick two players. Both their hands are laid out, one row each, and you pick one card from each row. The two cards trade places. This can bust both of them at once.

Discard - pick a player, then pick one of their cards to throw away.

Every one of these cards can only be pointed at a player who is still drawing. Once you have stopped - or busted - nobody can steal from you, swap your cards, make you discard, or hand you a penalty. Stopping keeps you safe.

If there is nobody left to play them on they simply do nothing: Steal and Discard need one other player still drawing, and Swap needs at least three players still drawing.
Default.naughtySpecialNumbersText:
The Zero - your score for the round becomes 0 unless you make a Rainbow draw, and you are forced to keep hitting for the rest of the round.

Unlucky 7 - there is one of these in the deck. The moment you draw it, every other number and modifier card in front of you is thrown away. All you keep is the 7. The other six 7s are ordinary cards.

Lucky 13 - there is one of these in the deck, and it is the only 13 that does not clash. You can hold it alongside an ordinary 13 without busting. Two ordinary 13s still bust you.
Default.penaltyVictimQuestion: ($1), you drew the ($2) - pick who has to take it!
Default.zeroLockText:
You are holding The Zero, so your Stay card is gone - you have to keep hitting for the rest of the round.

Your score for the round is 0 unless you get all the way to a Rainbow, which is now the only thing worth playing for.

Get rid of it and you are free again - a Steal or a Discard played on you takes it away.
